top_signals.title: Stocks End Lower as Rate-Hike Odds Climb After Hot Inflation
top_signals.summary: US equities fell Tuesday as Treasury yields surged after Federal Reserve officials called for rate hikes in response to hotter-than-expected inflation data.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Barrick Mining Files to Take North American Gold Assets Public
top_signals.summary: Barrick Mining Corp. filed for a US initial public offering of its top North American gold assets, as the Canadian miner looks to reset strategically.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
top_signals.summary: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Rep. Jim Jordan, Sen. John Thune elected GOP leaders in Congress
top_signals.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., announced the day after Election Day he would not run for minority leader in the 120th Congress.
